summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd, a NASDAQ-listed China-based company, filed a Form 6-K announcing the indefinite postponement of its extraordinary general meeting (EGM), originally scheduled for September 4, 2026. The board, via unanimous written resolutions dated September 1, 2026, postponed the EGM under Article 69 of its articles of association, which permits cancellation or postponement of a conventioned general meeting before it is held. No business was conducted, proxy cards will be disregarded, and shareholders will be re-asked to vote on rescheduled matters. The company will announce new dates, times, locations, and record dates, distributing fresh materials in due course. The prior EGM notice was furnished on August 27, 2026; the specific matter for the EGM is not disclosed in this excerpt, leaving the underlying purpose unknown. Watch for the rescheduled meeting date and purpose, as the indefinite postponement may signal a review or change in a proposed corporate action.
